$comment: Boundary fixtures for PPh 23 + versioned BPPU migration (Task 5). Every expectation encodes a verified primary-source fact from UU 7/1983 jo. UU 36/2008 (PPh) Pasal 23 ayat (1) huruf c angka 2 / ayat (1a), PMK 141/PMK.03/2015, and the NIK-as-NPWP chronology (PMK 112/2022, PMK 136/2023, PENG-6/PJ.09/2024). Land/building rent is governed by PPh 4(2) final per PP 34/2017 (effective 2 Januari 2018) — encoded here only as a PPh 23 scope-exclusion marker (rate not_applicable) so the resolver never returns a 2% PPh 23 answer for it. Rates are stored as decimal fractions (0.02 = 2%). PPh amounts are 2-decimal currency strings in IDR. See data/v2/sources.json for primary locators.

effectiveDate.$comment: PPh 23 service rates under UU 36/2008 amendment became effective 1 Januari 2009. PMK 141/PMK.03/2015 expanded the 'jasa lain' list and jumlah bruto mechanics, promulgated 27 Juli 2015 with Pasal 4 mandating a 30-day lag → effective 26 Agustus 2015.

serviceConcepts.$comment: PPh 23 ayat (1) huruf c angka 2: jasa teknik, jasa manajemen, jasa konstruksi, jasa konsultan, and PMK 141 'jasa lain'. Each concept is a distinct concept with explicit recipient conditions. Recipient must be a domestic taxpayer or BUT; the income must not already be PPh 21 (e.g. individual consultant fees paid in an employer-employee context); and no controlling final regime (e.g. PPh 4(2) for land/building rent, PPh 4(3) final construction) may apply.

officialBppuCodes.24-100-02: Sewa/perolehan lain atas harta selain tanah/bangunan yang sudah final PPh 4(2)

boundaries.description: PMK 141/PMK.03/2015 effective date is 26 Agustus 2015 (Pasal 4, 30-day lag from 27 Juli 2015). Day before (25 Agu 2015) the PMK-141 'jasa lain' concept must NOT yet apply — gap, not synthetic 2%.
On the PMK 141 effective date (26 Agustus 2015) the 'jasa lain' concept resolves with a 2% rate (recipient with NPWP).
Jevi's goal scenario: 'berapa tarif PPh 23 jasa konsultan tahun 2020?'. 2% of gross (excl. VAT) for a domestic-taxpayer recipient with NPWP. Source: UU PPh Pasal 23 ayat (1) huruf c angka 2.
Pasal 23 ayat (1a): recipient without NPWP (and no valid integrated NIK in 2020) pays 100% higher → 2% becomes 4%.
Without recipientHasNpwp fact, the multiplier branch is undecided → fakta_kurang, never a synthetic 2%.
Jasa manajemen 2020: 2% with NPWP. Distinct concept from konsultan — same rate family under Pasal 23(1)(c)(2).
Jasa teknik 2020: 2% with NPWP under Pasal 23(1)(c)(2).
Sewa harta selain tanah/bangunan remains PPh 23 2% (KOP 24-100-02) — NOT PPh 4(2) final. Recipient with NPWP.

Before PP 34/2017 took effect (1 Januari 2018), persewaan tanah/bangunan was PPh 23 final 10% (UU PPh Pasal 4(2) lama). For 2017 we still surface it under the PPh 23 scope marker as not_applicable-to-2% with a note that it was the old final 10% regime.
From PP 34/2017 effective 2 Januari 2018, persewaan tanah/bangunan is FINAL PPh 4(2) 10% — excluded from PPh 23. The PPh 23 concept carries rate not_applicable and a note pointing to PPh 4(2).
Per PENG-6/PJ.09/2024, a Masa Pajak Januari 2024 resident-individual recipient with a Dukcapil-integrated NIK is treated as having NPWP — the ayat (1a) 100% multiplier does NOT apply.
Bare NIK without activation during the transition does NOT remove the ayat (1a) multiplier. A 2023 recipient without activated NPWP pays 4%.
Before UU 36/2008 took effect (1 Januari 2009), the modern PPh 23 service-rate regime does not apply — gap, not a synthetic number.

bppuVersioning.$comment: BPPU/KOP codes are first-class versioned reporting metadata with their own validity interval and source. They are NEVER the rate authority. The 24-104-0x codes' 'Berlaku' date in the KOP CSV is 2022-02-21 (KEP-143/PJ/2022); the canonical PPh 23 service rates themselves long predate that under UU 36/2008 + PMK 141/2015. The form chronology (PER-04/PJ/2017 → PER-23/PJ/2020 → PER-24/PJ/2021 → PER-11/PJ/2025 Coretax/BPPU) is encoded as the source registry and the BPPU validity interval, not as the rate.
